assertions: Listeners execute as UID/GID 65534 with zero inherited, permitted, effective, bounding and ambient capabilities
Production device-binding helper accepts permitted veth ingress before and after negative checks
LAN source 10.210.2.2 and routed CGNAT source 100.100.2.2 cannot connect to bound listener
Unbound control accepts every corresponding route
Fresh namespaces use no Tailscale firewall rules; reverse-path filtering disabled only in those namespaces
After interface deletion and recreation with a different kernel index, old bound listener refuses permitted and LAN routes while unbound control accepts them
New bound listener on recreated interface restores permitted ingress and refuses LAN/CGNAT routes
limits: Veth surrogate, not production point-to-point TUN or running-daemon identity admission
Raw TCP fixture, not installed HTTPS gateway/controller or systemd confinement
Does not qualify actual Tailscale ACLs, physical devices, passkeys or relays
Does not include later watched-child real-interface observation or executable TLS shutdown test
